test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 

108 × 27 ÷ 3 - 19 + 95 = 88
solution:
BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e12be954b5385eed2305cd57cd62384dcc289e6e23ff21bfe0f5bad01a501f8.png] 

Option 1) - and +

After interchanging the mathematical sign We get,

⇒ 108 × __**27 ÷ 3**__ + 19 - 95 = 88

⇒ __**108 × 9**__ + 19 - 95 = 88

⇒ __**972 + 19**__ - 95 = 88

⇒ __**991 - 95**__ = 88

⇒ 896 ≠ 88

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the mathematical sign We get,

⇒ 108 + __**27 ÷ 3**__ - 19 × 95 = 88

⇒ 108 + 9 - __**19 × 95**__ = 88

⇒ __**108 + 9 **__- 1805 = 88

⇒ __**117 - 1805**__ = 88

⇒ -1688 ≠ 88

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ÷ and ×

After interchanging the mathematical sign We get,

⇒ __**108 ÷ 27 **__× 3 - 19 + 95 = 88

⇒ __**4 × 3 **__- 19 + 95 = 88

⇒ __**12 **__- 19 __**+ 95**__ = 88

⇒ __**107 - 19 **__= 88

⇒ 88 = 88

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) - and ×

After interchanging the mathematical sign We get,

⇒ 108 - __**27 ÷ 3**__ × 19 + 95 = 88

⇒ 108 - __**9 × 19 **__+ 95 = 88

⇒ __**108**__ - 171 __**+ 95**__ = 88

⇒ __**203 - 171**__ = 88

⇒ 32 ≠ 88

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "÷ and × ".
